intro: El Salvador is a presidential republic where power has become concentrated in the president.

chapters.title: How it works
text: Nayib Bukele was re-elected in 2024 after courts allowed a second term, and in 2025 the constitution was changed to allow unlimited re-election and a six-year term. The Legislative Assembly is dominated by his party.

chapters.title: Mega-prison
text: The CECOT prison, one of the largest in the Americas, has held deportees from the US.
